mapper.delete:
update t_groups a left join t_groups_person b on a.id = b.groups_id set a.is_deleted =1, b.is_deleted =1 where a.id in
#{id}
mapper.select: select id, groups_name, groups_person_number, creator, create_date, updater, update_date, experiment_id, is_deleted, scene_id, process_dag, model, data_collection from t_groups where experiment_id = #{planId} and is_deleted = 0 order by id
select secret from t_groups where is_deleted = 0 and id = #{groupId}

select a.id, a.experiment_name, a.experiment_code, a.experiment_scene, b.groups_person_number experimentPersonNumber, a.experiment_contact, a.contact_email from t_experiment_plan a join t_groups b on a.id = b.experiment_id and b.is_deleted = 0 where a.is_deleted = 0 and b.id = #{id}

SELECT DISTINCT jt.materialId FROM t_groups, JSON_TABLE ( process_config, '$[*]' COLUMNS ( type VARCHAR ( 255 ) PATH '$.type', materialId VARCHAR ( 255 ) PATH '$.config.material.materialId' )) AS jt WHERE jt.type = 'intervene';

SELECT DISTINCT jt.questionnaireId FROM t_groups, JSON_TABLE ( process_config, '$[*]' COLUMNS ( type VARCHAR ( 255 ) PATH '$.type', questionnaireId VARCHAR ( 255 ) PATH '$.config.questionnaireId' )) AS jt WHERE is_deleted = 0 and jt.type = 'collection';

SELECT DISTINCT jt.dialogueId FROM t_groups, JSON_TABLE ( process_config, '$[*]' COLUMNS ( type VARCHAR ( 255 ) PATH '$.type', dialogueId VARCHAR ( 255 ) PATH '$.config.dialogueId' )) AS jt WHERE is_deleted = 0 and jt.type = 'dialogue';

select a.groups_id groupIds, b.id experimentIds from t_groups_person a left join t_experiment_plan b on a.experiment_code = b.experiment_code and a.experiment_name = b.experiment_name and b.is_deleted = 0 where a.is_deleted = 0 and a.user_id = #{userId}

select experiment_name experimentName, groups_name groupsName, process_config from t_experiment_plan a left join t_groups b on a.id = b.experiment_id and b.is_deleted = 0 where a.is_deleted = 0 and b.id = #{experimentId}

SELECT jt.id AS elementId FROM t_groups tg, JSON_TABLE ( process_config, '$[*]' COLUMNS ( id VARCHAR ( 255 ) PATH '$.id', questionnaireId LONG PATH '$.config.questionnaireId' )) AS jt WHERE tg.id = #{groupId} AND tg.experiment_id = #{experimentId} AND jt.questionnaireId = #{questionnaireId} and tg.is_deleted = 0

SELECT DISTINCT jt.questionnaireId AS elementId, tg.experiment_id, tg.create_name FROM t_groups tg, JSON_TABLE ( process_config, '$[*]' COLUMNS ( type VARCHAR ( 255 ) PATH '$.type', questionnaireId VARCHAR ( 255 ) PATH '$.config.questionnaireId' )) AS jt WHERE tg.is_deleted = 0 and jt.type = 'collection';

SELECT DISTINCT jt.dialogueId AS elementId, tg.experiment_id, tg.create_name FROM t_groups tg, JSON_TABLE ( process_config, '$[*]' COLUMNS ( type VARCHAR ( 255 ) PATH '$.type', dialogueId VARCHAR ( 255 ) PATH '$.config.dialogueId' )) AS jt WHERE is_deleted = 0 and jt.type = 'dialogue';

SELECT DISTINCT jt.materialId AS elementId, tg.experiment_id, tg.create_name FROM t_groups tg, JSON_TABLE ( process_config, '$[*]' COLUMNS ( type VARCHAR ( 255 ) PATH '$.type', materialId VARCHAR ( 255 ) PATH '$.config.material.materialId' )) AS jt WHERE tg.is_deleted = 0 and jt.type = 'intervene'

SELECT tg.id, tg.process_config FROM `t_groups` tg, JSON_TABLE( process_config, '$[*]' COLUMNS ( type VARCHAR(255) PATH '$.type' ,materialId VARCHAR ( 255 ) PATH '$.config.material.materialId' )) AS jt WHERE jt.type='intervene' AND jt.materialId = #{materialId}

SELECT distinct jt.id FROM t_groups tg, JSON_TABLE( process_config, '$[*]' COLUMNS ( type VARCHAR ( 255 ) PATH '$.type', id VARCHAR ( 255 ) PATH '$.id' ) ) AS jt WHERE tg.is_deleted = 0 and tg.id = #{groupId} and jt.type = 'chatroom';
select b.experiment_scene from t_groups a left join t_experiment_plan b on a.experiment_id = b.id where a.id = #{groupId}

SELECT distinct jt.id elementId FROM t_groups tg, JSON_TABLE( process_config, '$[*]' COLUMNS ( type VARCHAR(255) PATH '$.type', id VARCHAR(255) PATH '$.id', sequence VARCHAR(255) PATH '$.sequence', materialType VARCHAR(255) PATH '$.config.material.type') ) AS jt WHERE tg.is_deleted = 0 and tg.id = #{groupId} and jt.type = 'intervene' and jt.materialType = 'MATERIAL_GROUP';
